description:
GitHub Download, https://github.com/OfflcerSam/TankSector/releases
Some of the template stuff is included in the source code stuff, if anyone wants to pick it apart and use it as their own template.

Requires, Nexerelin, MagicLib, and LazyLib
(No clue if this works with random generation, cause I forgot to test it.)

After 5 days, I think the mod is complete enough to release to the public. The mod seems to function and play, and there is some slight burnout from learning this much in the span of 5 days to create stuff this simple.
I might come back to this in the future with more guns, tanks, additional factions, and better art or scale. But for now I just want to see what people think a bit, my only driving force to make this is that it was funny.

I have a couple more mods in the works that actually have scale, this mod was more or less a funny mod for me to make and learn the game which I might continue.
(plan includes a somewhat to scale naval ship mod and two actual scifi factions with my friend as the artist)

What does this mod do?
Creates upscaled tanks as ships, and there was no method to scaling or anything.
As a result several things might still be unbalanced, and don't expect good art cause I didn't really try to make good art just something as a placeholder.

This mod is not meant to be serious in any manner, just a reminder.

aiDescription: Introduces the United States Military Junta and Greater German Space Reich factions. Adds various tank-themed ships, including light tanks, medium tanks, heavy tanks, armored cars, and trains. Includes a wide array of weapons such as turrets, bazookas, and rifles to match the new vessels.
